title: Assets in Agentic SOC: merged assets, Risk Score and Risk Mass, columns, filters and charts

prose.label: Scores and columns.
prose.text: {{risk-score-and-mass}} {{other-columns}} The reconciliation function and views are open {{gap:asset-details}}.

what-an-asset-is.statement: Each asset represents a single entity in the environment, unified (merged) and enriched with information from multiple sources; the Assets page lets you view the sources and records it was merged from, the findings it contains and the tickets it is related to.

quotes: Each asset represents a single entity in your environment, unified (i.e., merged) and enriched with information from multiple sources.
view the sources and records from which it was merged, view the findings it contains, and view the tickets it's related to.

filters-grouping.statement: You can filter assets by Sources, Type, Site or Operating System, group them by fields such as Asset State, Asset ID or Asset Owner ID, and export the list and its details as a CSV file.

quotes: Filter assets by Sources, Type, Site, or Operating System.
Group assets by fields such as Asset State, Asset ID, or Asset Owner ID.
Export the list of assets and their associated details as a CSV file.

overview-charts.statement: The Assets page charts the number of assets in risk score ranges (in increments of 0.5, the X-axis being the max severity score of active findings related to the asset), the asset count by type (the 5 most frequently occurring types) and the count by operating system (the 5 most frequent).

quotes: Displays the number of assets in the different risk score ranges (in increments of 0.5)
The X-axis represents the max severity score of active findings related to the asset
Presents asset count categorized by asset type, displaying the 5 most frequently occurring types.
Displays the number of assets categorized by OS, displaying the 5 most frequently occurring types.

risk-score-and-mass.statement: When the default Active saved view is selected, an asset's risk score is initially set by the default reconciliation function and reflects the highest severity score among its findings, a default that can be customized through data unification; Risk Mass is the sum of all severity scores of the active findings associated with the asset.

quotes: When the default Active saved view is selected, you can see the following details for each asset
The risk score is initially set by the default reconciliation function and reflects the highest severity score among the findings.
The default can be customized through data unification.
Risk Mass: The sum of all severity scores of the active findings associated with the asset.

other-columns.statement: The same view also shows Type (for example Windows Workstation, Web Application, Container Image), Owner ID, Is Crown Jewel (a Boolean of TRUE or FALSE), First Seen, Total Findings and Tags pulled from your sources.

quotes: Type: The asset type (e.g., Windows Workstation, Web Application, Container Image).
Is Crown Jewel: A Boolean field with values of TRUE or FALSE
Owner ID: The unit within the organization assigned to handling the asset.
First Seen: The earliest date on which a finding on the asset was first detected.
Total Findings: The sum of the active findings per severity.
Tags: Tags pulled from your sources
